items.definition: To make a process work by machine or computer, with little or no human control.
examples: The bank has automated most of its customer enquiries.

items.definition: To make a spare copy of computer files so that you do not lose them.
examples: Remember to back up your photos before you update the phone.
I lost a whole essay because I hadn't backed it up.

items.definition: An important discovery or development that solves a problem or allows great progress.
examples: Researchers announced a breakthrough in battery design.

items.definition: Using the newest and most advanced ideas or methods.
examples: The hospital uses cutting-edge technology to scan patients.

items.definition: A small machine or piece of equipment made for a particular purpose, such as a phone or tablet.
examples: Most people now read the news on a mobile device.

items.definition: A small, clever tool or machine that does something useful or entertaining.
examples: My brother loves buying every new gadget as soon as it comes out.

items.definition: To get into someone else's computer system or account without permission.
examples: Someone hacked her email account and sent spam to all her contacts.

items.definition: To put a program on a computer so that it is ready to use, or to fit a piece of equipment.
examples: You need to install the latest version before you can log in.

items.definition: To enter a username and password to start using a website or computer system.
examples: I can't log in because I've forgotten my password.
Please log in to your account to see your orders.
The ticket machine malfunctioned, so we had to queue at the desk.

items.definition: No longer used because something newer and better has replaced it.
examples: Many shops fear that cash will soon become obsolete.

items.definition: The right to keep your personal information and activities secret from other people.
examples: Many users worry about their privacy when they share photos online.

items.definition: The programs that a computer uses to do different jobs.
examples: The company has developed new software for booking appointments.

items.definition: To send a file from your own computer or phone to the internet or another system.
examples: She uploaded the holiday photos to a shared album.

items.definition: Easy to understand and to use, even for someone with little experience.
examples: The new banking app is much more user-friendly than the old website.
